issue.title: Classify legacy changespec guard-provider fixtures in terminology audit
issue.description: Reproduced on 2026-08-12 while verifying an unrelated AXE PNG fixture split: just check passes fmt, Ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, and changelog, then tools/audit_patch_stitch_terminology fails with exactly three unclassified changespec tokens at tools/validate_sase_core_rs:606 and tests/test_validate_sase_core_rs_tool.py:430,504. These literals intentionally exercise the schema's legacy changespec guard-provider compatibility alongside patch, so the audit needs an explicit legacy-compatibility classification (or the fixtures/schema contract must be updated consistently). Impact: the normal repository gate is deterministically red for unrelated changes. Scope: classify or migrate the three occurrences, retain coverage of the intended guard-provider contract, and verify the terminology audit plus focused validator tests.

evidence.note: Independently reproduced during the unrelated test_axe_chop_bead_task_triage.py split on 2026-08-12: just check passed fmt, Ruff, mypy, pyscripts, test-waits, and changelog, then the terminology audit failed on the same three unclassified changespec tokens at tools/validate_sase_core_rs:606 and tests/test_validate_sase_core_rs_tool.py:430,504. The focused 19-test task-triage suite passed, so this is unrelated to the split and deterministically blocks the repository gate.
